banners.name: showcase-desk
banners.title: Desk and phones
banners.description: The card in a desktop window (Light) between a Dark phone and a Light phone, on the app's lavender day; the phones are one held moment in both themes.

banners.name: showcase-phones
banners.title: Three phones
banners.description: Three phones on the violet night: Dark, Light (centre, raised) and Dark, from one running card.

banners.name: showcase-daynight
banners.title: Day and night
banners.description: The widget's original banner, current: two tablets, Light and Dark, at one held moment of the feed, on a ground from lavender day to violet night.

banners.name: focus-heatmap
banners.title: The heatmap
banners.description: The heatmap's well lifted out of the card and laid back on the app's own violet: 96 cells of the Primary role, each cell's heat its opacity.

banners.name: focus-figures
banners.title: Figures and arrows
banners.description: The monthly and yearly totals with their drawn arrows (one up, one down) in Dark, focused like a tilt-shift lens while the heatmap and regions fall away.

banners.name: focus-regions
banners.title: Top regions
banners.description: The top regions panel with rises and a fall, lifted out of the card at 1.5x in front of the card itself, out of focus.

banners.name: focus-card
banners.title: The card
banners.description: The whole card in Dark, flat and sharp, standing on a dark violet floor that mirrors it, back-lit.

banners.name: stylized-split
banners.title: Light and Dark split
banners.description: One card at one held moment, Light and Dark, cut on a diagonal at the angle of its own drawn arrow: the figures and the heatmap continue across the cut.

banners.name: stylized-palettes
banners.title: Four palettes
banners.description: The theme does the look: the same card from four builds with different palettes (violet, teal, magenta, orange), alternating Light and Dark, each on a band of its own palette.

banners.name: stylized-stack
banners.title: Every two seconds
banners.description: The heatmap's well at six moments of one running card, two seconds of feed apart, stacked oldest to newest like layers of time.

banners.name: stylized-split-titled
banners.title: Split, titled
banners.description: stylized-split with the display name "Sales Heatmap" in Roboto Medium on the day side.

notes: Light/Dark pairs come from one held moment (Playwright's page clock paused between feed snapshots), so their figures and heatmap agree exactly; across moments the figures differ, as the feed moves every 2 s.
showcase-desk: the window is a later moment than the two phones; showcase-phones: the right phone is a later moment than the left and centre ones (all one session).
stylized-palettes uses three extra builds with generated palettes (teal, magenta, orange seeds; material-color-utilities Fidelity) besides the shipped violet; each card is its own build and session.
Whole-screen showcases and the four-card palettes banner carry UI text below 10 px at 1x; focused banners keep text at 10 px or more.
Only text-free planes (the heatmap well, the stack) are tilted; every element with text is flat.
No third-party brands: the card names places (Los Angeles, New York, Canada).
